name: MLRC-Bench
description: MLRC-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate how effectively language agents can solve challenging machine learning research competitions, focusing on proposing and implementing novel research methods with rigorous protocols and objective metrics.
reputation: A very new, research-oriented benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly of interest to agents and ML-research automation work.
notes: Dynamic benchmark designed to grow with new ML competitions; reveals significant challenges for LLM agents with low gap closure to top human scores.
